verifier: adversarial verifier (self-review against source; no independent subagent was spawned). Read: src/controller/state.rs 1-1250 plus test-name index, src/controller/state/{mixer.rs 1-460 and 615-640, session_reports.rs 1-62 and 136-412, bookmarks.rs 1-150, audio_presets.rs 1-30 and 95-145, report_history.rs 1-30 and 115-145, show_registry.rs (grep)}, src/controller/observations.rs 1-80, src/ui/event_reconciliation.rs 1-215 and 270-360, src/ui/navigation.rs 120-212, src/architecture_tests.rs 510-681, plus greps. No cargo commands were run.
summary: Verified 25 findings: 12 confirmed, 13 adjusted, 0 refuted. The overall diagnosis holds: AppState and WorkspaceState are god structs, and the per-context Extract Class plan is sound. Corrections that implementers must apply: (1) AppState has 47 fields, not 41, and WorkspaceState has 31, not 30 (counted state.rs:438-498 and 193-228). (2) The 559 borrow_mut() count covers every RefCell in src; the AppState-specific receivers (state/nav.state/self.state) number about 308. (3) Any AppStore that uses glib::idle_add cannot live in src/controller/, because architecture_tests.rs:669-681 (background_layers_hold_no_gtk_or_ui) forbids glib:: and crate::ui there. Put it in src/ui/state_store.rs. (4) ObsStatus::label cannot move to ui/, because the controller calls it at state.rs:755, 859 and 861, and controller may not import crate::ui. Also, the repo convention already puts icon_name/css_class on domain types (domain/graph.rs:44-53, domain/diagnostic.rs:32-41, domain/audio.rs:63), so -08 is a project-wide convention decision, downgraded to low. (5) The -05 line refs 270-353 point into the test module (tests start at event_reconciliation.rs:208). The production reducers there already call touch() at the end (lines 30, 51, 176), so the revision invariant is held in that file. The risk is the other roughly 140 external field writes. (6) -06 overstates three fences. HealthMonitor is not a fence: it is called only after accept_output_observation passes (state.rs:663-666, event_reconciliation.rs:119-121). The real asymmetry is that Observations (holding stream_revision/record_revision) is reset on collection change (state.rs:844), while the Instant fence survives collection change by design (state.rs:603-604). (7) -12: the Instant::now() in set_obs_stats_at (1168) is a separate `now` argument to health.observe_stats, not a duplicate of `at`. update_active_since (state.rs:186) also hides Instant::now() and was missed. (8) The session_reports unwrap lines are off by one: 276, 280, 326, 392. (9) The mixer loading forwarder caller is ui/pages/mixer.rs:1150, not ui/window.rs:1153 (that line is success; failure is at 1163). (10) WorkspaceState::invalidate must keep `activity` (report collection depends on its monotonic sequence(): session_reports.rs:277-292) and must keep `revision` monotonic (render key). A naive `..Default::default()` rewrite would reset both, so it needs explicit carry-over. Split proposals are confirmed with adjustments: keep label in controller/domain, place the store in ui/, and when the mixer view model moves to ui/pages/mixer/view_model.rs, ui/window.rs:1386 (visible_mixer_render_source) must import from there.

findings.title: AppState is a 41-field god struct spanning 9 bounded contexts
findings.evidence: pub struct AppState (437-499) holds connection, collection/topology, outputs, telemetry, active audio, mixer, persistence caches, audit, current_page and workspace. impl AppState is spread over state.rs, mixer.rs, audio_presets.rs, bookmarks.rs, session_reports.rs, report_history.rs and show_registry.rs. Most fields are pub.
findings.recommendation: Extract Class one slice per step under controller/state/<context>.rs: ConnectionState, CollectionState, OutputsState, TelemetryState, ActiveAudioState, MixerState, LocalStore, AuditState. health stays top-level. AppState keeps only the cross-slice transitions (apply_connected, reset_obs_session, invalidate_collection_runtime, apply_terminal_evidence, note_command_intent). Each step goes through a temporary delegating accessor.
findings.risk: Every context change touches one 1245-line type. reset_obs_session (853-880) lists fields by hand.
findings.verifier_note: Field count is 47, not 41. Counted every field line at state.rs:438-498, including the private preset_serial, topology_revision, stream_observed_at, record_observed_at, record_path_observed_at, active_audio_revision and observations. Diagnosis and plan confirmed. Implementer caveat: child modules read private AppState fields directly (bookmarks.rs:126 reads self.record_observed_at; session_reports.rs:139-140 reads connected_connection_id/connected_endpoint; audio_presets.rs:14 reads preset_serial). Every extracted slice must expose pub(super) accessors for these readers, or the step will not compile. reset_obs_session range 853-880 verified.

findings.title: WorkspaceState is a second god struct (30 public fields, 6 concerns)
findings.smell: Large Class, Data Clumps, Temporary Field
findings.evidence: The fields mix read fencing, control observations, source inspection, readback snapshot, a screenshot clump and audit. invalidate (367-397) resets the fields one by one.
findings.recommendation: Make it a module controller/state/workspace/ with fence.rs (ReadFence), controls.rs (GlobalControls), inspection.rs (SourceInspection), screenshot.rs (ScreenshotCache), readback.rs (WorkspaceReadback) and audit.rs (WorkspaceAudit). Rewrite invalidate as `*self = Self { fence: self.fence.next_epoch(), audit: self.audit.retire(now_ms), inspection: InspectionTokens::continuing(..), ..Default::default() }`.
findings.risk: A new field missing from invalidate() survives collection or session changes.
findings.verifier_note: 31 fields (193-228): 29 pub plus the private next_operator_inspection and revision. invalidate is at 367-397 as stated. The struct-update rewrite needs these carry-overs, or it introduces regressions. (a) `revision` must advance (touch), not reset to 0, because it is the render key; resetting it can make the UI miss a redraw when the old and new values collide. ReadFence::next_epoch must bump epoch, sequence and revision. (b) `activity` must be kept: invalidate does not clear it today, and session_reports.rs:277-292 depends on ActivityLog::numbered()/sequence() staying monotonic for gap detection. (c) output_results is invalidated (invalidate(unix_ms)), not cleared. (d) `result` and `recording_stop_result` are cleared. (e) next_operator_inspection is kept, while operator_inspections is cleared. So WorkspaceAudit::retire must keep activity, invalidate output_results, and clear result and recording_stop_result. The guarding test is state.rs:1813 every_visible_workspace_mutation_advances_the_revision.

findings.title: Stream/record data clump and duplicated set_stream_*/set_record_* method pairs
findings.smell: Data Clumps, Duplicate Code, Switch Statements
findings.evidence: Four parallel field pairs (465-473); eight mirrored setters (1086-1141); a per-kind match in apply_output_event, accept_output_observation and apply_terminal_evidence.
findings.recommendation: Create controller/state/outputs.rs with OutputChannel { status, command_error, active_since, observed_at } and OutputsState { stream, record, recording: RecordingEvidence } with channel_mut(kind). Keep #[deprecated] delegates for one step. The guarding tests are state.rs:1989-2426.
findings.risk: An asymmetric fix applied to only one of the pair.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed in state.rs. The cited ui line refs need correcting: in ui/event_reconciliation.rs, update_active_since with the direct state.stream_active_since/record_active_since writes is at 126-133, and the set_stream_status/set_record_status switch is at 135-138. That is a fifth per-kind switch, and it writes the pub active_since fields from ui/. OutputsState must therefore expose `observe_readback(kind, Option<&OutputStatus>, at)` covering accept, active clock and status, so event_reconciliation stops touching the fields. Note also that #[deprecated] items fail `cargo clippy -D warnings` at every remaining call site (the deprecated lint is warn by default and -D promotes it), so either migrate all callers in the same commit or add a scoped #[allow(deprecated)]. Test-name ranges 1989-2293 confirmed as stream/record symmetric pairs.

findings.title: Telemetry fields are a data clump updated only together
findings.evidence: Written together in set_obs_stats_at (1153-1179) and cleared together in clear_obs_stats (1181-1188). session_reports reads them as a group. Encoding is derived at 1160-1166.
findings.recommendation: Extract controller/state/telemetry.rs TelemetryState { latest: Option<TelemetrySample>, history } with record() and clear(). Move the encoding derivation to domain::health::EncodingActivity::from_outputs. Pass now explicitly.
findings.risk: Partial updates cause stale or mismatched telemetry in reports.
findings.verifier_note: Clump confirmed: fields at 487-498, writes at 1167-1178, clears at 1181-1188, and the session_reports group read at 316-331 (not 320-335). One correction: the Instant::now() at 1168 is a distinct `now` argument to health.observe_stats(stats, stream, recording, encoding, at, now), not a redundant copy of `at`. The recommendation should be 'add a `now: Instant` parameter', not 'reuse `at`'. Also note that stream_bitrate_kbps depends on stream_status.active (1172), so TelemetryState::record needs the stream-active bool passed in. Keep it a parameter to avoid a slice-to-slice dependency.

findings.title: The workspace reducer lives in ui/ and writes WorkspaceState fields directly
findings.smell: Feature Envy, Inappropriate Intimacy, Indecent Exposure
findings.evidence: acknowledge, media_loaded and complete_workspace mutate workspace fields directly. 164 direct mutations exist outside the scope.
findings.recommendation: Move these functions to controller/state/workspace/reducer.rs as WorkspaceState/AppState methods. Make the fields pub(super) and have the mutators bump the revision internally. ui/event_reconciliation.rs keeps only the dispatch.
findings.risk: A forgotten touch() means no redraw, and any page can corrupt the fence fields.
findings.verifier_note: Production code is lines 20-206. Lines 270-353 are in `mod tests` (starts at 208), so drop those refs. All five production reducers already end with touch() or mark_dirty() (30, 51, 176, 184, 205), so the revision invariant currently holds inside this file. The real exposure is the other writers. A grep of `.workspace.<field> =/.push(/.clear()` outside controller/state gives 177 hits, including test lines: operating_panel.rs 40, event_reconciliation.rs 36, ui/workspace.rs 19, action_catalog.rs 19, operator_picker.rs 12, window.rs 11. The move is architecture-safe: these functions use only fl!, unix_ms and domain types, so architecture_tests' background_layers rule is not violated. Also move audio_failed (179-184) and replay_saved (186-206). complete_workspace also writes output state (113-138), so it belongs on AppState and should delegate to OutputsState::observe_readback (see -03). Current return type is bool, so ShellEffects is optional.

findings.title: Three independent fences for the same observation (revision, Instant, health)
findings.evidence: observations.rs:64-75 holds a revision fence; accept_output_observation (605-615) an Instant fence; HealthMonitor::observe_output gets `at`. Topology and active-audio revisions live in AppState while program and inputs live in Observations, and they are reset in different places (841, 844-845).
findings.recommendation: Add a domain/revision.rs Fence<T: Ord> value object, give each slice its own fence, move the reconcile branches into slices, reduce Observations to input echoes, and write an ADR first.
findings.risk: A reset clears one fence but not its sibling.
findings.verifier_note: Two fences, not three. HealthMonitor is downstream, not a fence: it is called only after accept_output_observation succeeds (state.rs:663-666; event_reconciliation.rs:116-121). The fences guard different things. The Observations revision fence (observations.rs:64-75) orders controller-published events by wire revision. The Instant fence (state.rs:605-615) orders events against workspace readback (event_reconciliation.rs:116). Both are legitimate, so keep both and document them. The asymmetry is real: invalidate_collection_runtime resets Observations, including stream_revision/record_revision (844), while stream_observed_at survives until reset_obs_session (874-875). The comment at 603-604 makes that a deliberate choice for the Instant fence only. The revision reset to 0 is benign because the Instant fence still guards, but nothing documents it. Lines 841, 844 and 845 verified. Recommendation confirmed, with the ADR stating which fence is equality and which is ordering (ties to -11).

findings.title: One OBS input fact is denormalized into 4 copies and patched by duplicated code
findings.evidence: apply_input_mute (1196-1214) and apply_input_volume (1218-1238) each patch audio_inputs, the mixer snapshot, workspace.audio and workspace.detail. Observations::merge_workspace_audio patches a 5th view.
findings.recommendation: Short term: add domain::audio::InputPatch and AppState::apply_input_patch. Long term: a normalized InputStore. Guard with the test at state.rs:2455, extended to cover workspace.detail.
findings.risk: A new input view misses echoes.
findings.verifier_note: Lines verified. The doc comment at 1190-1195 still says 'two places' while the code patches four, which is drift worth fixing in the same change. The test at 2455 does not touch workspace (grep of 2452-2487 finds no 'workspace'), so the extension is warranted. One asymmetry to preserve: detail.volume_db is patched but there is no detail volume_mul. InputPatch::apply_detail must reproduce exactly that. merge_workspace_audio (observations.rs:28-61) is an echo merge onto an incoming readback, not a stored copy, so it stays in Observations. It is not a fifth stored copy.

findings.title: Presentation (GTK icon names, CSS classes, Fluent strings) in the controller state
findings.evidence: Page::id/title/icon_name, ObsStatus::label/css_class, TopologyStatus::notice and active_audio_notice live in the controller.
findings.recommendation: Move them to src/ui/presenters/status.rs and src/ui/page_meta.rs with PageView/ObsStatusView extension traits.
findings.risk: Coupling.
findings.verifier_note: Downgrade to low. (1) ObsStatus::label cannot move to ui/: the controller calls it at state.rs:755 (finish_report(&ObsStatus::Connecting.label())), 859 and 861, and architecture_tests.rs:669-681 forbids crate::ui in src/controller. Keep label where it is, or move ObsStatus to domain with label, matching domain::role label and domain::control::WorkspaceWarning::label, which already use fl!. (2) The repo convention already puts icon_name/css_class on domain types: domain/graph.rs:44-53, domain/diagnostic.rs:32-41, domain/audio.rs:63. Moving only the controller copies would make the code base inconsistent. Either decide it project-wide (ui/presenters for all four types) or leave it. What is safe to move now: Page::id and icon_name (consumers are ui-only), ObsStatus::css_class, TopologyStatus::notice (ui/pages/graph.rs:74, doctor.rs:120, and tests at state.rs:1836-1876, which would move too) and active_audio_notice.

findings.title: apply_output_event is a 110-line long method that orchestrates 5 contexts
findings.smell: Long Method, Feature Envy, Switch Statements
findings.evidence: Fencing, health, activity logging, path evidence, the stop ticket, report acks and status are handled in one function, with two match blocks (675-683, 685-748).
findings.recommendation: Split into OutputsState::apply(&AppEvent) -> Option<OutputTransition>, AppState handling of the transition, and a RecordingStopTicket value in domain/output_result.rs.
findings.risk: Ordering bugs between path evidence and the fence.
findings.verifier_note: Line refs verified (fence 663, health 666/676-682, logs 668-672/725-726/742-743, path 658-662/686-689, ticket 717-720/731-741, acks 711/716). Ordering constraint for the implementer: observe_recording_path must run before the Instant fence (658-662 precede 663; comment at 656-657), and an early return when the fence rejects must still return Some(kind), not None (664). OutputTransition must encode 'fenced out but path evidence applied'. Guarding tests are at 1358 (output_events_track_clocks_paths_and_the_recording_stop_ticket), 1478 and 1550.

findings.title: collect_report (140 lines) and begin_report reach into 7 slices; repeated unwrap on current()
findings.smell: Long Method, Feature Envy, Message Chains
findings.evidence: collect_report reads 7 slices and calls reports.current().unwrap() 4 times. begin_report calls back_mut().unwrap() twice. The alert mapping is at 337-360.
findings.recommendation: Move the alert key mapping to domain; add ReportsState::collect(ReportInputs) split into collect_* phases bound to current_mut() once; use a single back_mut or SessionReport::with_unique_id.
findings.risk: Moving the early return turns the unwraps into a GTK-thread panic.
findings.verifier_note: The unwraps are at 276, 280, 326 and 392 (off by one in the original), back_mut().unwrap() at 158 and 161, and the archive scans at 169-177 and 201-209. The alert mapping is at 339-365 (kind 339-352, phase 357-361). The unwraps are currently safe: the early return is at 273-275, and ReportsState::push (55-60) never ends the report. Severity medium is more accurate than high: the risk is maintainability, not a live panic. The SystemTime nonce plus process::id at 162-168 is a hidden clock and environment dependency; injecting it is the right fix for deterministic tests.

findings.title: Four inconsistent counter-overflow policies across slices
findings.evidence: wrapping_add (236, 368-369, 410); checked_add().expect (1038-1041, mixer.rs:131-134, 191-194); += 1 (show_registry.rs:50, 84, 115; session_reports.rs:58, 154); checked_add()? (audio_presets.rs:14).
findings.recommendation: Add domain/revision.rs Generation(u64) with one documented policy. Keep the fail-closed tests at mixer.rs:620-638.
findings.risk: Mostly theoretical with u64; readability.
findings.verifier_note: Every cited site was verified. Cargo.toml sets no overflow-checks, so `+= 1` wraps in release and panics in debug, as stated. The mixer tests at 620-638 use #[should_panic], so they must change in step with any new policy. Do not use one policy everywhere blindly: Observations and topology use ordering comparisons (`revision < self.topology_revision`, state.rs:1000), where wrapping would silently accept stale replies. Use saturating or fail-closed for ordering fences and wrapping only for equality fences (WorkspaceState::accepts compares with ==, state.rs:433).

findings.title: Hidden clock dependencies inside reducers (Instant::elapsed, Instant::now, unix_ms)
findings.evidence: elapsed() at 256/327/331; unix_ms in invalidate/log; Instant::now in apply_connected/invalidate_collection_runtime/reset_obs_session/apply_terminal_evidence/set_obs_stats_at.
findings.recommendation: Thread an explicit Now { instant, unix_ms } into the reducers, created once per tick in ui/event_pump.rs.
findings.risk: Timing-dependent tests; inconsistent timestamps within one reducer.
findings.verifier_note: Confirmed, with three corrections. (1) The missed site update_active_since (state.rs:186) calls Instant::now(), and ui/event_reconciliation.rs uses it too. (2) At 1168, Instant::now() is a separate `now` argument, not a duplicate of `at` (see -04). (3) The event pump alone cannot create Now. Reducers are also entered from GTK callbacks: NavigationContext::dispatch calls note_command_intent with unix_ms() (ui/navigation.rs:207-210), as do ui/event_reconciliation.rs and the pages. Build Now at every GTK entry point; a small `Now::capture()` in ui/ called by each adapter will do. event_reconciliation also calls unix_ms() at 27, 74, 90, 160 and 165.

findings.title: Magic numbers for control freshness and retirement history
findings.evidence: The 30 s freshness check appears 3 times; the history limit 32 is at 937; bookmarks.rs uses Duration::from_secs(5).
findings.recommendation: Add CONTROL_FRESHNESS in domain/control.rs, RETIREMENT_HISTORY in connection.rs and RECORDING_SAMPLE_MAX_AGE in domain/bookmark.rs.
findings.risk: One freshness check drifts from the others.
findings.verifier_note: 256, 327, 331 and 937 verified. The bookmarks constant is at bookmarks.rs:126, not 127. Note the boundary semantics: 256 and 327 use `<= 30` while 331 uses `> 30` (its negation), and all three compare whole seconds via as_secs(). `is_fresh` must keep the whole-second truncation (age <= 30.999 s counts as fresh), or behavior changes at the boundary.

findings.title: Pure domain rules live as controller methods instead of in domain/
findings.evidence: previous_scene_for_inventory_update, update_active_since, the WorkspaceState control policy, the mixer refresh target and the bookmark recording-time derivation.
findings.recommendation: Move to SceneInventory::advance, domain::output::ActiveClock, domain::control::ControlAvailability, MixerSelection::refresh_target and RecordingTime::sample, leaving 1-line delegations.
findings.risk: Rules are hard to find and reuse.
findings.verifier_note: Verified: 170-179, 182-188, 247-348, mixer.rs:326-365, bookmarks.rs:124-147. All targets are in domain/, and the candidates import neither storage nor GTK, so domain_types_depend_on_neither_gtk_nor_obs and domain_and_services_do_not_reach_into_storage stay green. MixerSceneRefreshTarget<'a> borrows &str from MixerSelection or the inventory, so refresh_target(&self, current: Option<&'a str>) needs explicit lifetimes. The ActiveClock move must take `now` as a parameter (see -12) rather than keep Instant::now() inside domain.

findings.title: Storage serde types are held directly as runtime state (no anti-corruption layer)
findings.evidence: AppState holds AppConfig and SceneRegistry. bookmarks.rs:8 and report_history.rs:4 hold storage archives. workflow_scope reads config.obs.host/port.
findings.recommendation: Add domain snapshots (ShowCuration, ConnectionTarget, WorkspaceKey moved to domain). Keep the serde structs in LocalStore. Add an architecture test limiting crate::storage imports in controller/state to local_store.rs.
findings.risk: Schema changes leak to 181/117 references.

Implementers should note that storage types are also read inside session_reports.rs:178-187 (config.connection_profiles(), config.session_history) and report_history.rs:115 (config.session_history.limit()). Moving WorkspaceKey/RegistryTarget into domain is allowed (domain is forbidden only from importing storage, not from defining types that storage then uses).

findings.title: OBS password stored as plain String in a Debug + Clone god struct
findings.evidence: #[derive(Debug, Clone)] pub struct AppState contains pub obs_password: Option<String>. ui/pages/settings/connections.rs:113 and 121 touch it.
findings.recommendation: Move it into LocalStore as Option<SecretString> with a redacting Debug, and expose fn obs_password() -> Option<&str>. Drop Clone if possible.

The secret also flows as a plain Option<String> through storage::secret (secret.rs:33-49), controller/dependencies.rs:18, 42 and 67, and app.rs:45 and 636. A SecretString confined to AppState is partial hardening; scope the newtype to the dependencies trait too, or call the AppState change a first step. findings.title: 1840-line inline test module with shared fixtures leaked to sibling tests
findings.evidence: The tests module is 60% of state.rs; it exports pub(super) fixtures used via `use super::super::tests::*` (mixer.rs:455).

findings.risk: Huge mixed diffs otherwise.

Collect them by grepping `pub(super) fn` rather than by line range. The mixer test import is at mixer.rs:455 (`use super::super::tests::*`). After the move it becomes `use crate::controller::state::tests::fixtures::*`, and fixtures must be `pub(in crate::controller::state)` or pub(crate) under cfg(test).
